items.item: The browser tab title is unique and describes the Forgot Password page.
items.notes: document.title = "frontend-web" on /forgot-password.

items.item: Step 2 primary and secondary actions are visually distinguishable.
items.notes: “Đặt lại mật khẩu” and “← Quay lại” are both full-width green buttons with identical styling.

items.item: The Forgot Password page has no horizontal scrolling at a 360px viewport.
items.notes: scrollWidth = clientWidth = 360.

items.item: The Profile page has exactly one h1 and a logical heading hierarchy.
items.notes: 0 <h1> and two <h2> elements (“Hồ sơ của bạn”, “Lịch sử đơn hàng”).

items.item: The browser tab title is unique and describes the Profile page.
items.notes: document.title = "frontend-web" on /profile.

items.item: The order-history table remains usable at 360px without page-level horizontal scrolling.
items.notes: Page scrollWidth 399px vs clientWidth 360px (39px overflow); the 5-column table keeps its desktop width.

items.item: Profile text and order-status badges meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
items.notes: axe-core: #fde047 on #2563eb = 3.92:1; white on #ef4444 = 3.76:1.

items.item: The layout remains usable when the document direction is RTL.
items.notes: With dir="rtl", physical Tailwind utilities keep the “Quên mật khẩu?” link right-aligned and the header unchanged; the layout is not mirrored.

items.item: Text remains legible when the operating system uses dark mode.
items.notes: No dark theme is implemented, but the explicit white card and black text stay legible under colorScheme=dark.

items.item: Content reflows at 200% zoom (640 CSS px) without horizontal scrolling.
items.notes: Login, Register and Forgot Password all report scrollWidth = clientWidth = 640.

items.item: The email/username field uses an input type appropriate for email.
items.notes: type="text" and the label says “Username”, although the backend expects an email.

items.item: The password field masks entered characters.
items.notes: type="text" — the password is visible on screen.

items.item: Every input has a programmatically associated label.
items.notes: Labels have no for/id; axe-core reports 2 critical “label” violations.

items.item: Required fields are enforced with native validation on empty submit.
items.notes: Both inputs have required; browser reports “Please fill out this field.” and focuses the first empty field.

items.item: The email field uses type=email and rejects malformed addresses.
items.notes: type="text"; “not-an-email-<timestamp>” was accepted and the app redirected to /login.

items.item: The password field masks entered characters.
items.notes: type="password".

items.item: The password rule text matches the implemented validation.
items.notes: Text promises “ký tự đặc biệt”, but the regex requires whitespace and rejects special characters; “Abcd1234!” is rejected.

items.item: A confirm-password field prevents mistyped passwords.
items.notes: Only one password input is present.

items.item: The email field uses type=email and validates the address format.
items.notes: type="text"; malformed addresses are only rejected by the backend after submission.

items.item: The OTP field restricts input to four digits (inputmode/maxlength/pattern).
items.notes: type="text", maxlength=-1, no inputmode or pattern; arbitrary text is accepted.

items.item: The new-password field masks entered characters.
items.notes: type="password".

items.item: The reset form requires password confirmation.
items.notes: Step 2 has only one “Mật khẩu mới” input.

items.item: The email field is read-only and clearly marked as non-editable.
items.notes: disabled + label “Email (Không đổi)”.

items.item: The phone field uses tel inputmode and constrains its format.
items.notes: type="text"; no inputmode="tel", pattern, minlength or maxlength.

items.item: Phone validation feedback is inline and associated with the field.
items.notes: Uses alert(); the regex /^[1-9][0-9]{8,9}$/ rejects every 0-prefixed Vietnamese number, including the placeholder 0912345678; no inline error.

items.item: All Profile labels are programmatically associated with their inputs.
items.notes: All four labels lack for/id; axe-core reports critical label violations.

items.item: The global header is present and its links work on the Login page.
items.notes: Header contains EShop, Giỏ hàng, Đăng nhập, Đăng ký; all navigate correctly.

items.item: The Forgot Password link uses client-side routing and does not reload the document.
items.notes: Raw <a href="/forgot-password">; a window marker was lost after the click, proving a full reload.

items.item: The “Đăng ký ngay” link navigates to /register.
items.notes: Navigates to the Register screen.

items.item: Keyboard tab order follows the visual order.
items.notes: The Sign In button has tabindex="1", so the first Tab from the page focuses it before email/password.

items.item: Header navigation is present and consistent with Login.
items.notes: Same header links and styling.

items.item: The “Đăng nhập” link navigates to /login.
items.notes: Navigates to Login.

items.item: Keyboard tab order follows the visual order.
items.notes: Header → name → email → password → Đăng Ký → login link.

items.item: Successful registration returns the user to Login.
items.notes: navigate('/login') after a successful POST.

items.item: Going back to step 1 preserves the entered email.
items.notes: Email state is retained after “← Quay lại”.

items.item: There is a way back to Login from Forgot Password.
items.notes: Header “Đăng nhập” link is available.

items.item: Focus moves to the new step's first field after a step transition.
items.notes: After “Lấy mã OTP”, document.activeElement is BODY; focus is not moved to the OTP field or heading.

items.item: Step 2 shows a step indicator (for example 2/2).
items.notes: No progress indicator or step count is shown.

items.item: Unauthenticated access to /profile redirects to Login with a return path.
items.notes: URL stays /profile and only “Vui lòng đăng nhập” is rendered; no redirect or return path.

items.item: The header shows the authenticated state and a working Profile link.
items.notes: “Chào, <name>” links to /profile; “Thoát” is present.

items.item: Logout returns the user to a public page.
items.notes: After “Thoát”, the URL remains /profile and the page shows “Vui lòng đăng nhập”.

items.item: The current page is indicated in navigation.
items.notes: No aria-current, active class or visual state identifies the current page.

items.item: Authenticated users are redirected away from /login.
items.notes: A logged-in user still sees the Login form; the header shows the authenticated state at the same time.

items.item: The submit button shows a loading/disabled state while authenticating.
items.notes: During a delayed /api/login the button stays enabled with the label “Sign In”; no spinner or aria-busy.

items.item: The login error is inline and announced to assistive technology.
items.notes: Error div has no role="alert" or aria-live; no field association.

items.item: The login error text distinguishes wrong credentials, account lockout and network failure.
items.notes: Only “Đăng nhập thất bại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.” is shown for every failure.

items.item: Successful login gives clear feedback and redirects.
items.notes: Redirects to / and the header changes to “Chào, <name>”.

items.item: Successful registration gives success feedback before redirecting.
items.notes: Redirects silently to /login; no success message.

items.item: Duplicate-email registration is rejected with a human-readable message.
items.notes: Registering the same email twice both redirected to /login; no error (backend has no unique constraint).

items.item: Server errors do not expose technical details.
items.notes: The catch block renders err.response.data.error directly; a simulated 500 produced “SQLITE_ERROR: no such column: name”.

items.item: The submit button shows a loading/disabled state while registering.
items.notes: During a delayed /api/register the button stays enabled and keeps the label “Đăng Ký”.

items.item: A successful OTP request is shown clearly.
items.notes: A green box and step 2 are shown after the request.

items.item: The OTP is not exposed in the UI.
items.notes: Step 2 shows “Mã OTP của bạn là: 2129” in a green success box.

items.item: The invalid-email error is inline and non-blocking.
items.notes: Uses alert(“Lỗi: User not found”); no inline message, field highlight or live region.

items.item: Reset success and failure feedback is clear.
items.notes: The success and failure outcomes are distinguishable (success alert + redirect to /login; failure alert). The blocking alert modality itself is reported in CHK-59 and CHK-61.

items.item: Profile update success is shown inline and announced.
items.notes: Uses alert(“Cập nhật thành công!”); no inline message, aria-live region or focus/state update.

items.item: Order history shows a loading state.
items.notes: During a delayed /api/orders/my-orders the empty state “Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.” is already visible; no spinner/skeleton/aria-busy.

items.item: Order-history errors are distinguished from an empty list.
items.notes: A 500 response sets orders=[] and the UI says “Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.”; no error or retry.

items.item: The cancel-order action asks for confirmation before executing.
items.notes: “Hủy đơn” calls the API immediately; no “Bạn có chắc?” confirmation. It is also offered for a “Đang giao” order.

items.item: Order status is conveyed by text, not colour alone.
items.notes: statusLabel() maps each status to Vietnamese text next to the coloured badge.
